types.name: AdaptiveStepperProps
types.doc: A numeric stepper that never changes size. Digits roll up or down to the new value, and the minus or plus button folds away at the minimum or maximum while the number slides over to keep the control balanced. Hold a button to keep stepping. The number is a spinbutton: arrow keys, Page Up and Down, Home and End all work.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Runs with the new value after every step.

members.name: min
members.doc: Lowest value. The minus button folds away here.

members.name: max
members.doc: Highest value. The plus button folds away here.

members.name: step
members.doc: Amount added or removed per press.

members.name: largeStep
members.doc: Amount for Page Up and Page Down. Defaults to five steps.

members.name: formatValueText
members.doc: Spoken form of the value, for example `value => value + " guests"`.

members.name: name
members.doc: Field name: adds a hidden input so the value submits with a form.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the control off: it is dimmed and ignores pointer and keyboard input.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.
